uiEnglish.welcomeBody: NIDAN helps the care team prepare for your visit in your language. It does not diagnose and does not replace doctors.
uiEnglish.localDemo: Local kiosk demo · no real Aadhaar data
uiEnglish.t1d: English plus 22 Indian languages are available. Non-English UI and clinical translations are drafts and need review.
uiEnglish.t2d: Every question can be heard and answered by speaking or tapping.
uiEnglish.t3d: Urgent warning signs are shown at once and sent to staff.
uiEnglish.langDesc: Your language stays selected for the whole intake. You can say the language name or tap a card.
uiEnglish.tr_other: UI in English · type & speak in your language

uiEnglish.v_ptype: Please say new patient or returning patient.

uiEnglish.consentDesc: Please read and agree before we continue.
uiEnglish.c1: NIDAN prepares a history for the care team. It does not diagnose and does not replace a doctor.
uiEnglish.c2: Your answers stay on this device in this prototype, and you can edit them before continuing.

uiEnglish.concernDesc: Tell us what brings you in, then confirm the matching card.
uiEnglish.v_concern: Please tell us what problem brings you here today.
uiEnglish.bodyDesc: Tap a body area or choose Not sure. Related questions follow.
uiEnglish.tapHurt: Tap if this is where it hurts

uiEnglish.ayHistDesc: Patient-reported answers; a practitioner will confirm them.
uiEnglish.v_ayHist: Please say your answer, or tap an option.
uiEnglish.qDesc: These questions change with your main concern. Tap an answer or speak.

uiEnglish.stays: Your answer stays on this kiosk and can be edited before continuing.
uiEnglish.speakNat: Speak naturally. You can change the words before continuing.

uiEnglish.hMeds: Which medicines do you take now?

uiEnglish.repDesc: Optional: add a prescription or report by camera, file, or typing.
uiEnglish.repSafety: Safety signals found in the report text will be shown to staff.
uiEnglish.ocrNote: This text was read automatically and may contain mistakes. Please check and correct it.

uiEnglish.typedPh: Type or paste the report text here
uiEnglish.v_rep: You may add a report now, or continue without one.
uiEnglish.safeDesc: We checked everything you entered for urgent warning signs.
uiEnglish.safeNone: No urgent warning signs were detected in what you entered. This is not a medical clearance — tell staff at once if you feel worse.
uiEnglish.emTitle: Please seek urgent medical help now
uiEnglish.emBody: A warning sign was found: {x}. This is not a diagnosis. Tell staff now, call 112 in India, or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait to finish this intake.
uiEnglish.sumDesc: Check your answers. You can go back to change anything.
uiEnglish.h_reports: Reports (text as read from the document — unverified)
uiEnglish.disclaimer: NIDAN is not a diagnostic tool. This summary lists only what the patient entered or what was read from uploaded documents, for review by a qualified clinician.
uiEnglish.revDesc: For the care team: read the handoff, add notes and mark it reviewed.
uiEnglish.doneDesc: Your intake is ready for the care team. Please wait — staff will call you.
uiEnglish.guideTip: For clear capture: speak one sentence at a time, keep the microphone close, and check the words before continuing.
uiEnglish.editHint: You can also edit the text above.
uiEnglish.noRecog: Voice recognition is not available in this browser. Please type your answer.
uiEnglish.noVoice: No installed voice for this language, so it cannot be read aloud here. Please read the text.
uiEnglish.micDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it in the browser, or type your answer.
uiEnglish.noSpeech: I could not hear clearly. Please try again or type.
uiEnglish.unclear: I could not tell which option you meant. Please tap one.
uiEnglish.helpBody: Tap the speaker to hear a question. Tap the microphone to answer, then check the words and tap “Yes, correct”. You can always type or tap instead. If you feel very unwell, tell staff at once or call 112.
uiEnglish.confirmReset: Clear this session and start over?
uiEnglish.required: Please answer this question or use “Skip this question”.
uiEnglish.needConsent: Please tick the box to agree before continuing.
uiEnglish.needPick: Please choose an option to continue.
uiEnglish.qChanged: What has changed since your last visit?
uiEnglish.feelDesc: Welcome back. Tell us how you are today compared with your last visit.
uiEnglish.researchOpt: Optional: allow my answers, with name and phone removed, to help improve this hospital’s own AI. Saying no changes nothing about my care.
uiEnglish.aiProcessOpt: Optional: I agree to let this hospital’s configured local AI process my visit information to prepare an unverified draft summary or translation for staff. This is not for training; saying no does not affect my care.
uiEnglish.aiProcessDesc: Separate, optional, and off by default. If you leave this unchecked, no AI processing is requested for this visit. A local model may still be unavailable; any draft requires staff review and is not a diagnosis or treatment.
uiEnglish.draftTr: Draft translation: not yet reviewed by a native speaker or clinician. Ask staff if anything is unclear.
uiEnglish.forChild: I am answering for my child
uiEnglish.forOther: I am answering for a family member
uiEnglish.relation: Your relation to the patient (e.g. mother)
uiEnglish.proxyNote: Please answer about the patient, not about yourself.
uiEnglish.errRel: Please write your relation to the patient.
uiEnglish.pregQ: Is the patient pregnant, or could she be?
uiEnglish.guardian: I am the parent / legal guardian, or authorised to answer for this patient.

uiEnglish.voiceBody: If you allow voice, your browser sends the recording to its speech service (Google for Chrome, Microsoft for Edge) to turn it into text. NIDAN does not store audio. You can type instead.
uiEnglish.voiceOff: Voice is off (you chose typing only). Tap the mic to change.
uiEnglish.alertSent: Staff have been alerted. Please stay here.
uiEnglish.alertLocal: The alert is on the staff screen. Please also tell the nearest staff member now.

uiEnglish.handoff: Your intake has been handed to the care team. Only staff can open it.

uiEnglish.handwriting: Low confidence: handwriting or a poor photo is often unreadable. Please type the key lines or ask staff to read the original.
uiEnglish.unverified: UNVERIFIED — staff must check against the original

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:allergy_medicine:label: Did you take any medicine for this reaction? If so, what and when?

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:allergy_trigger:label: What might have triggered the reaction, and when were you exposed?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:allergy_urgent:label: Is there swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat, or any breathing difficulty now?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:chest_character:label: How would you describe it?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:chest_current:label: Are you having the chest pain or pressure right now?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:chest_onset:label: When did it start, and how did it begin?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:chest_onset:placeholde: For example: suddenly while walking, 30 minutes ago

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:chest_spread:placehold: Tell us what applies, or write no
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:cough_duration:label: How long have you had the cough or breathing problem?

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:cough_fever:placeholde: Tell us what applies, or write none
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:cough_severity:label: How difficult is breathing right now from 1 to 10?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:cough_trigger:label: Does anything trigger or relieve it, such as activity, lying down, dust, or medicine?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:cough_type:label: Is the cough dry, or are you bringing up mucus?

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:ent_onset:label: When did it begin, and is it changing or spreading?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:ent_swallow:label: Are you having trouble swallowing fluids or breathing comfortably right now?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:ent_symptoms:label: Have you noticed fever, discharge, reduced hearing, blocked nose, or a hoarse voice?

clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:eye_onset:label: When did it begin, and is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:eye_side:label: Which eye is affected, and what change or discomfort have you noticed?
clinicalEnglish.clinical:question:eye_signs:label: Is there pain, redness, discharge, light sensitivity, or swelling?
